args: url=$OBSIDIAN_DEBUG_URL; if [ -z "$url" ]; then host=127.0.0.1; if [ -e /.dockerenv ] || [ -e /run/.containerenv ]; then host=$(ip route 2>/dev/null | awk '/^default/{print $3; exit}'); fi; [ -n "$host" ] || host=127.0.0.1; url=http://$host:9222; fi; exec npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest --browser-url="$url"
